function.name: edit
function.description: Edit an existing file using line anchors from a previous `read`/`grep`. Every anchor must still match; if the file changed you get the current lines back and must re-anchor. Give `old_string` to replace one exact occurrence inside the anchored region, or omit it to replace whole lines from anchors[0].line to end_line. A diff is recorded and diagnostics run afterwards.

path.description: Path relative to the project root.

anchors.description: Line/hash pairs copied from `read` or `grep` output. The first anchor is the first line of the edited region.

hash.description: 4-hex line hash as shown by read/grep.

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must occur exactly once in the anchored region.

end_line.description: Last line (inclusive) of the region when replacing whole lines.
